name: ROAD TO ZWIFT RACING LEAGUE
description:
Team up. Show up. Race together.

Zwift Racing League is team racing at its best: fast, sweaty, and addictive. Race alongside your teammates every Tuesday, combining teamwork, tactics, and competition with the kind of Type 2 Fun that keeps you coming back for more.

The 2026/27 season features four 6-week rounds from September to April, with new routes, a new format, XP rewards, and exclusive unlocks along the way. Round 1 gets underway on September 22.

YOUR ROAD TO ZRL STARTS HERE

Thinking about racing ZRL? This group ride is designed to show you what it’s all about and help you get ready for the start line.
Ride alongside other Zwifters as we introduce you to team racing, what to expect when you race ZRL, and how to take the next step and join a team.

There’s no racing today. Just ride with the group, learn more about ZRL, and get ready to race together.

READY TO RACE?

Once you've completed the ride, the next step is to find your team and get signed up.

Getting started is simple:

1 - Create your WTRL profile by connecting your Zwift account.
2 - Visit the ZRL Find a Team page for ways to find a team.
3 - Or register your own team and invite your friends.

REGISTER NOW
https://www.wtrl.racing/zwift-racing-league/

Enjoy the ride, keep the faith, and become that someone!

・BIKES: TTバイクは使用不可

あなたのFTPを体重で割った数値をパワーウエイトレシオ【○○W/kg】となります。

A:4.0W/kg FTP以上の方

name: RCC Global Club Ride
description:
WELCOME TO THE RAPHA CYCLING CLUB WORLD WIDE GROUP RIDE. 
 
This is a social group workout; a chance every week for members to get together from around the globe, ride, chat and support each other - it’s run as a group workout session with ‘keep everyone together’ enabled so no matter what your pace you’ll stay in the pack - it’s not a race or competition and open for anyone to join us. 
We host 4 rides every week on a Tuesday to suit different time zones around the world (aimed at evenings), join whichever time works best for you. 
 
WHO IS THE RCC?
 
The Rapha Cycling Club (RCC) is, as the name suggests, Rapha’s Cycling Club. The RCC exists to help connect like minded riders from all over the world, underpinned by Rapha’s products and experiences. We ride together across continents and here united within Zwift. 
 
For more information head to: www.Rapha.cc/rcc
 
RIDE LEADERS
 
The rides are led by our friendly team of member ride leaders from around the world.  The Leader (who has a yellow beacon over their head) will ride at a steady pace as set by the workout session. Prompts will appear on screen set by the workout designer Matt Rowe so you know what to do throughout the ride. On most occasions we will have a support ride leader (who will also have a beacon), the ride leaders are there to help support you and keep the banter going - to join the chat use the Zwift Companion smartphone app. 
 
ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS
 
Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.
 
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

Today's workout contains 4 x 6 minute blocks of Zone 3, with some surges thrown in for good measure! The Zone 3 riding should feel nice and comfortable, however the surges may sting a little. The surges in each block are only 20 seconds long, but at 110% of FTP so require a focused increase in effort .At the end of each 6 minute block, there is a 1 minute 'Free Ride' - this is your chance to turn an endurance based session into something special! Come event day or when riding with friends, it's likely you want some more power for that final sprint to the cafe right? Give it 100% in each 60 second Free Ride section to help you become more explosive! Stress points 45: #Social
 
 
WORKOUT DESIGNER
 
Matt Rowe is the founder of Rowe & King Coaching (www.roweandking.com) with 25 years of cycling experience, coaching amateur cyclists all over the world to  achieve their personal goals.
 
HELPFUL HINT
 
We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level.
You can adjust the difficulty of the workout mid-ride if needed, by using the up/down arrows on the left hand side, under the workout details.
 
HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

description:

[D] Cruising - 1.8 w/kg to 2.4 w/kg plus OD Last Lap, Sprinting - Rider’s choice

⦁We will be supported by our Red Leader, when available to help you get back to the main group if you have dropped off.
⦁This is not a race or ego-trip so learn to ride as a team. Your ability to work as a team is highly appreciated.

Join us every week on Tuesday at 6:30am PT for a fun, social ride appropriate for all levels. Laugh and smile as you pedal along with ride leaders Jack Nosco, Janel Spilker and other Nosco Sherpas.

The Michael P. Nosco Foundation's mission is to provide financial relief to families and/or individuals who are confronting a life threatening illness. The foundation's mission is realized by organizing an annual cycling event held on November 3rd, affectionately known as the Nosco Ride, that brings together 1000+ cyclists from all over the world to ride in support of these families. name: The Grind Finale
description:
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

This session aims to replicate the demands of a mountain bike ride / event. 

Mountain biking generally involves far more variations in effort compared with road riding - so plenty of surges and time spent being over geared! We also spend a lot of time on and off the power, so short spells going  hard to get over an obstacle, followed by a freewheel or very low power on a descent or little dip.

We touch upon all of these aspects in todays session, as we start off alternating every 30 seconds between riding hard at a low cadence, and riding easy - as if we are riding through an undulating single track. Then we make a ramp in effort, which finishes with a 30 second near max effort up a steep, rocky banking!

WORKOUT DESIGNER

Matt Rowe - Heavily involved in cycling for the past 25 years, Matt represented Great Britain at the Junior World Championships before graduating to the pro ranks. Matt draws on his extensive race experience to help amateur cyclists around the world achieve their personal goals. 

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop. 

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level. For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

description:
Team up. Show up. Race together.

Zwift Racing League is team racing at its best: fast, sweaty, and addictive. Race alongside your teammates every Tuesday, combining teamwork, tactics, and competition with the kind of Type 2 Fun that keeps you coming back for more.

The 2026/27 season features four 6-week rounds from September to April, with new routes, a new format, XP rewards, and exclusive unlocks along the way. Round 1 gets underway on September 22.

YOUR ROAD TO ZRL STARTS HERE

Ride alongside other Zwifters as we introduce you to team racing, what to expect when you race ZRL, and how to take the next step and join a team.

description:
Welcome to the Zwift Women’s Training Club workouts! 

ZWTC is your community for fun and fitness. Our weekly workouts will take you through some of Zwift’s most popular training plans, and with the flexibility to join in any time, regardless of where we are in the plan! Get the most out of your Zwifting with training designed by world-class coaches, like 3x Olympic Gold medalist, Kristin Armstrong!

The group workouts will be held every 3 hours UTC on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We’ll also offer recovery rides every 3 hours on Wednesdays - be on the look out for special guests joining those! Our main goal is to provide you with a consistent experience week in and week out, to challenge yourself in a supportive group setting, making friends and getting fit along the way!

name: CAF Ride
description:
Join the Challenged Athletes Foundation on their weekly ride, every Tuesdays at 7:10am PT. You can join the group on discord for Q&A: https://discord.gg/geCAgqnNyr 

On this ride, you’ll learn more about Steven Peace, 16 years tenure Navy Veteran, who became 1 of only 3 people in the United States to competitively ride the upright tricycle. Since he began riding, Steven has won Para-Cycling US Nationals (9 times), medaled in UCI World Cups (30 times), and competed in UCI World Championships (8 times)

The Challenged Athletes Foundation strives to provide opportunities and support to people with physical and visual disabilities, so they can pursue active lifestyles through physical fitness and competitive athletics. The CAF Cycling Club is a year-round local club in San Diego, the Bay Area, Idaho, and remotely which provides adaptive athletes and non-adaptive athletes the opportunity to ride anywhere in the world and be a part of #TeamCAF. Membership includes a free cycling jersey, monthly email information, sponsor and CAF discounts, a supportive cycling community and more!

https://www.zwift.com/clubs/12f0e125-1fb8-4d78-8da2-b39efca4bffb/home

name: Lance Watson's Champion Intervals
description:
Join this custom designed interval workout by Hall of Fame Coach Lance Watson! Accomplish the same style of workout Coach Watson prescribed to win Ironman, Olympic Gold, and countless age group championships. Our Tuesday rides focus on threshold work to ensure quality Zone 4 energy zones are part of your training week. This challenging 60 minute ride is live-coached by Lance and is guaranteed to make you a stronger cyclist. The rides are banded and all levels are welcome - we’ll all stick together.

About Lance Watson: Lance Watson is a Triathlon Hall of Fame coach who has coached at numerous World Championships and four Olympic Games. An Ironman Master Coach, Lance specializes in coaching athletes of all abilities with busy life schedules who want the most out of their available training time. Lance is the founder and owner of LifeSport Coaching in Victoria, Canada and the innovator behind Lance Watson’s TRiCLUB, the first online club that offers structured team workouts and live, interactive coaching sessions using Zoom and Zwift. For more information visit www.lifesportcoaching.com. For a free coaching consult, book a call at https://calendly.com/lifesport-triclub/30min

name: Braunstein Cycling Club Danish Group Ride
description:
This is a social group workout; a chance every week for members to get together from around the globe, ride, chat and support each other - it’s run as a group workout session with ‘keep everyone together’ enabled so no matter what your pace you’ll stay in the pack - it’s not a race or competition and open for anyone to join us.

WHO IS THE BCC?

The BRAUNSTEIN Cycling Club (BCC) is, as the name suggests, Braunstein brewery’s Cycling Club. The BCC is a danish social Cycling club were we share our passion for Cycling.

For more information head to: www.braunstein.dk/bcc2

RIDE LEADERS

The rides are led by our friendly team of member ride leaders. The Leader (who has a yellow beacon over their head) will ride at a steady pace as set by the workout session. On most occasions we will have a support ride leader (who will also have a beacon), the ride leaders are there to help support you and keep the banter going - to join the chat use the Zwift Companion smartphone app.

Map/Route — Wattopia
Distance/Time/Laps — 1 hour
Type of Event - Group Ride
ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.

name: Dubai Roadsters Club ride
description: This is a fast paced, fun ride at the top end of the C category. It is not a race, just a pacey bit of fun. The average speed for the ride is aprx 40kph and the average watts/kilo is 2.9 to 3.0 each week, although the nature of the lumpy Central Park course can cause this to spike a couple of times each lap. The focus of the ride is to have fun and enjoy riding in a fast moving peloton.

name: DBR Tuesday Race
description:
Welcome to DBR Tuesday Race.
All will start with 1 minute between RS categories. Expect each race to be highly competitive and have fun.
Categories
Each race will be using Zwift Racing Score (ZRS) for categorization.
race up a category, if your RS is at the top end of a category. Or if you simply desire an added challenge.
- A: 1000 =< 690
- B:690<520
- C:520<350
- D:350<180
- E:180<=0
Your Zwift Racing Score is determined by how much success you have in races.
better against people with higher ZRS, then your ZRS may increase. If you place worse than people with lower ZRS, then your score might decrease. Read more about ZRS here - https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh <https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh>
If your ZRS increases past a category boundary during the series, your points earned will not transfer to the new category with you.
RULES:
Smart trainer or power meter is required. zPower will be removed.
Heart rate monitors are compulsory for all categories.
No TT bikes unless it's a TT event.
You need to have a registered account with Zwiftpower.com and accept their terms and conditions to be in the results of the race.
Misc.
Race organizers may request riders in all categories to provide a dual recording or a matching RL effort (Strava) in order to verify a Zwift race effort. Failure to comply may result in disqualification from the event. Failure to provide a dual recording or RL effort on three requests may result in disqualification from future events, until a dual recording with a matching effort is provided.
Race organizers may exclude a rider from the results, due to poor sportsmanship. Examples may be bad language, sandbagging or other behavior of a disruptive manner.

description:
Transform Your Winter with Endurance Nation’s OutSeason Program!

Get ready to build next-level fitness with our 9-week OutSeason cycling series! Join us every Tuesday and Thursday for a focused, one-hour session designed to boost your strength, endurance, and power. With just two workouts per week, you’ll start building winter strength that will prepare you to reach your goals next season. This program is tried-and-true, with over 10,000 athletes using it to succeed in cycling and triathlon for over 16 years.

description:

Pick the closest pace group for you, but all groups will start together and you are free to fall back and run ahead. The pace groups designate average pace for the duration of the run. Most groups will start slower and finish faster than the indicated pace. Feel free to mix in some intervals and race your friends. #pbt

name: Dusk Patrol Run
description:
DESCRIPTION

Join Utah-based marathon runner Jordan Maddocks who will lead a 45-60 minute speed session.

Welcome to Dusk Patrol 'Zwift Academy Run' Edition. Each week we will do a speed workout from the 2020 Zwift Academy Run catalog (catalog can be found in the training folder on the home screen). We will do one of the 8 workouts each week in chronological order every Tuesday at 7AM Mountain / 9AM Eastern. Each workout ranges between 45-60 min. These workouts were built to help strengthen athletes of all abilities and help build for race day. All of the workouts use your 10K speed bias setting in Zwift -- this pace time can be adjusted in settings to increase/decrease level of difficulty. Need More Speed? If you're looking for an additional speed workout during the week you're welcome to join us for Thursday Dusk Patrol which starts at same time (8:30AM MT/10:30AM ET).

ABOUT

ABOUT Jordan Maddocks
I'm a low 2:30's marathoner fighting out of Draper, Utah, USA. I’ve been running for over 15 years. Running is my passion, It's what keeps me centered and where I find solace. I love coaching and assisting others in setting their fitness goals and achieving them. I've been hosting Dusk Patrol on Zwift for over three years. When I'm not training I'm spending time with my momma bear and two cubs. Running has the magical ability to assist others in finding their greatness and I hope I can share that journey with you.

name: The Herd Gallops
description:
Looking to push the pace a little before The Herd's Tuesday Social? All are welcome to join The Herd on this supportive and social event.  Respect the leader's pace and ride with the yellow beacon. Although this is a faster paced ride, it is NOT A RACE! Stronger riders are encouraged to fall back and help sweep the riders struggling in the back.                                                                                 

The average pace for the ride with be 2.7-3.2 but will go up to 3.5-4WKG on climbs.

This season we will ramp up the pace every 3 weeks throughout the winter until we reach the goal of 2.7-3.2 for a hour.

name: MHG Run Club
description:
Back in January 2021, Eddie Izzard ran 32 marathons in 31 days. Our community rallied together and joined the action all month long. This inspired us to create the MHG Run Club, which continues Eddie’s incredible efforts of making humanity great.

The MHG Run Club motivates and supports everybody, whether you’re looking for tips to achieve your training goals or looking for a group to bond and socialize with. A light-minded Zwift treadmill runners group, for runners of all abilities, friendly chat and a good laugh :)

Please feel free to join me Clive Finnimore with our official MHG Run Club Lunchtime 5K @ 8KPH on Monday, Wednesday & Fridays, See you there soon :)

Keep on Running

name: Film My Run 500 with NoblePro
description:
Join Stephen Cousins and NoblePro for a 500 metre climb. Set your treadmill to 12% incline and run 4.2km of distance to reach 500 metres elevation. If your treadmill doesn't go that high, set it as high as it will go and join us anyway!

The run will be progressive starting at a walking pace of 5kph rising to 7kph for the final kilometre. Get on to the balls of your toes and get your calf muscles to do the work. This continuous uphill effort will help build strength and endurance for those hilly trail runs

This event is sponsored by the ever popular Noble Pro treadmills. You can get a discount on a NoblePro SMART treadmill from this link https://zwift.run/noble-pro

You can watch the run on the live stream at http://youtube.com/ZwiftRunChannel

Join the FMR Run Club for more fun events at https://www.zwift.com/uk/clubs/6afca04c-8fac-4ffa-b700-f27a73d7f3dd/join

name: ROAD TO ZWIFT RACING LEAGUE
description:
Team up. Show up. Race together.

Zwift Racing League is team racing at its best: fast, sweaty, and addictive. Race alongside your teammates every Tuesday, combining teamwork, tactics, and competition with the kind of Type 2 Fun that keeps you coming back for more.

The 2026/27 season features four 6-week rounds from September to April, with new routes, a new format, XP rewards, and exclusive unlocks along the way. Round 1 gets underway on September 22.

YOUR ROAD TO ZRL STARTS HERE

Thinking about racing ZRL? This group ride is designed to show you what it’s all about and help you get ready for the start line.
Ride alongside other Zwifters as we introduce you to team racing, what to expect when you race ZRL, and how to take the next step and join a team.

There’s no racing today. Just ride with the group, learn more about ZRL, and get ready to race together.

READY TO RACE?

Once you've completed the ride, the next step is to find your team and get signed up.

Getting started is simple:

1 - Create your WTRL profile by connecting your Zwift account.
2 - Visit the ZRL Find a Team page for ways to find a team.
3 - Or register your own team and invite your friends.

REGISTER NOW
https://www.wtrl.racing/zwift-racing-league/

name: Zwift Women's Training Club Workout
description:
Welcome to the Zwift Women’s Training Club workouts! 

ZWTC is your community for fun and fitness. Our weekly workouts will take you through some of Zwift’s most popular training plans, and with the flexibility to join in any time, regardless of where we are in the plan! Get the most out of your Zwifting with training designed by world-class coaches, like 3x Olympic Gold medalist, Kristin Armstrong!

The group workouts will be held every 3 hours UTC on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We’ll also offer recovery rides every 3 hours on Wednesdays - be on the look out for special guests joining those! Our main goal is to provide you with a consistent experience week in and week out, to challenge yourself in a supportive group setting, making friends and getting fit along the way! 

Join the Zwift Women’s Training Club to connect with new ride friends, ask questions, and get advice from experts.  https://www.zwift.com/clubs/ZwiftWTC/join

Love these workouts? Check out the club for more opportunities to train with us! We offer social rides every 3 hours on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays in addition to the Tuesday/Thursday workouts.

name: Team Africa Rising
description:
The Team Africa Rising Zwift Ride showcases our efforts in African cycling development. On this ride, you may be joined by some of our African cyclists from around the continent including Benin, Sierra Leone, Rwanda, DRC (Congo), and Uganda. Enjoy all the different African flags! You may even ride with former Rwandan Olympian (2012/2016) and World Tour cyclist (Team DiData), Adrien Niyonshuti.

We use this ride as a training and recovery ride for our African cyclists. We have Benin coaches who use this ride to train new Benin cyclists on how to shift, stay with the peloton and establish a consistent pedal stroke. So, you’ll be part of history during this ride! This event is run by members of Team Africa Rising, Adrien Niyonshuti, and all the up-and-coming coaches and cyclists of Benin and other countries to help them better learn to engage with fans and other riders. Sometimes we’ll have guest leads to talk to you about our work with Team Africa Rising.

The ride will remain a D+/C- ride. The team will adhere to the 1.5 - 2.0 w/kg range. The lead will ride at the top end, the sweep will ride at the lower end and will help riders if they want to make it back to the pack.

On this ride, we encourage chatting as it teaches the riders English. YOU will be a part of helping these young men and women build and lead their own rides. How cool is that?

You can follow us on our Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/groups/teamafricarising

Learn more about Team Africa Rising on our website: https://teamafricarising.org

name: Love Riding's 2.0wkg Coffee Ride
description:
Welcome to the Love Riding Club’s Coffee Ride! We meet every Tuesday for a casual, conversational
ride at a pace that falls within most people’s Zone 2 range (average pace between 1.8 – 2.2 wkg). We
are a friendly bunch and conversation is encouraged as it’s a great way to make sure you’re not going
too hard!
Sprinting is encouraged as long as you can make your way back to the group in time.
Tip: If you are new to sprints, it is best to sprint from the back of the pack to take advantage of the draft
and you won’t go out too far ahead of the group!

The lead yellow beacon will maintain the average advertised pace and the sweep red beacon will help
those who fall behind to catch up with the main group. We welcome riders who feel strong or want a
challenge to help the sweep team so please just shout up in the chat!

We tend to run the fence to help keep the group together, this will be relaxed at the sprints.
Please respect the lead beacon and make the effort to stay as close as possible to him/her for the benefit
of the whole group.

We LOVE to ride and we LOVE Coffee Rides! Looking forward to seeing you all on Tuesdays,
whether you’re warming up for a race, recovering, or just getting into cycling and this is at your
challenge level. We welcome you all!

Join us on Facebook to continue the chat, provide feedback and take part in how the club shapes in the
future.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/5437161913060756/

or Join our Zwift Club
Love Riding Club – find us in the club search
Find out events by filtering #loveriding

name: BRAUNSTEIN X VELOFIT CRIT SERIES
description:
Der er intet, der slår en helhjertet indsats på en tirsdag, så find din indre styrke - det bliver en fest, og gør dig klar til at give den alt. Vinderne kan prale indtil den følgende uge
 
Tilmeld dig vores Zwift klub BRAUNSTEIN X VELOFIT CYCLING CLUB her https://www.zwift.com/eu/clubs/417736f7-4abb-44e9-a6eb-75ec8f01b594/home
 
Det er tid til Race! Kom og vær med til sjov på en række korte ruter med flere omgange. Gør dig klar til at grave dybt og presse dig selv til målstregen!
 
Rute: Crit City
Omgang Distance: 1,9 km
 
Kategorier:
A: 4,0 - 5,0 w/kg - 15 omgange
B: 3,2 - 3,9 w/kg - 12 omgange
C: 2,5 - 3,1 w/kg - 10 omgange
D: 1,0 - 2,49 w/kg - 8 omgange
 
Hvordan låser jeg op for BCC Kittet?
 
Ikke nok med at du vil repræsentere kittet under begivenheden, men hvis du fuldfører nogen af vores ugentlige ture, låser du op for BCC Kittet i din garage, så du med stolthed kan bære BCC designet på enhver tur.
 
HVAD ER ZWIFT POWER? For yderligere oplysninger om at forbinde til Zwift Power, tjek denne supportside: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/connecting-to-zwiftpower-SyldRc_4H
 
Bemærk venligst; for at dine resultater vises i Zwift Power, skal du bruge et pulsmåler (HRM) og køre på en smart træner, smart cykel, eller bruge en effektmåler.
 
Om Braunstein Cycling Club:
Braunstein Bryggeriets Cykelklub er et blomstrende fællesskab af cykelentusiaster baseret i Køge og online på Zwift. Med mere end 500 medlemmer forener klubben cykelglæde og socialt samvær, både på de fysiske veje og i den virtuelle verden. Klubbens engagement i at skabe et varmt og indbydende miljø er åbenlyst, og det sociale aspekt vægtes lige så højt som den fysiske træning. Medlemmerne kan nyde samværet og den fælles passion for cykling, hvilket gør Braunstein Bryggeriets Cykelklub til et unikt og positivt samfund for cykelentusiaster. Besøg: braunstein.dk
 
Om Velofit:

description: This weekly training ride is not a coached session but designed for you to use as an excellent interval session. name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO race series. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

description:

name: SISU Punainen - Stage 2
description:
SISU Racing launches its boldest challenge yet: SISU Punainen, a Vuelta-inspired, seven-stage race series built for riders who thrive when the road tilts skyward. Set entirely in Watopia, this inaugural edition is unapologetically brutal, beautifully relentless, and designed for the mountain goats of the virtual peloton.

Riders will compete for three individual classifications, ensuring every stage offers something to race for. The coveted Punainen (red in FInnish) Jersey rewards the overall General Classification leader based on cumulative elapsed time across all seven stages. The Sprintteri Jersey recognises the fastest riders through the designated sprint segments, while the Vuorikauris (Mountain Goat) Jersey celebrates the strongest climbers.  Whether you're an all-rounder, a sprinter or a pure climber, there's a jersey to chase.
Just like the Vuelta, SISU Punainen rewards courage, consistency, and climbing prowess.

For more information, and results, visit sisu.racing/punainen.

The Stages

Stage 1
Hilly Route, Watopia (Individual Time Trial)
Sat 22 & Sun 23 August

Stage 2
Mayan San Remo, Watopia
Tue 25 & Wed 26 August

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 3
Three Little Sisters, Watopia
Sat 29 & Sun 30 August

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 4
Climbers Gambit, Watopia
Tue 1 & Wed 2 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 5
Big Loop, Watopia
Sat 5 & Sun 6 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 6
Mountain 8, Watopia
Tue 8 & Wed 9 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 7
Mountain Route, Watopia
Sat 12 & Sun 13 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather, Aero or Anvil


Zwift Race Score

In our ongoing effort to keep the racing scene fresh and competitive, the upcoming SISU Punainen series is embracing Zwift's flexible new Zwift Racing Score (ZRS) framework!
Following a format similar to the recent Zwift Tour Fever series, this shift away from standard Category boundaries allows us to create tighter, more closely matched fields.

What this means for you:

A Shakeup in the Pack: If you usually find yourself stuck in the middle of a traditional category, this is your chance to step up, animate the race, and battle for the win.
New Challenges for Front-Runners: Former category leaders will be pushed to find new limits against a freshly recalibrated field.
Dynamic Racing Throughout: While the elite action in A Grade will remain as fierce as ever, expect highly competitive, unpredictable, and dynamic racing across the board - especially in Cat D Grade and expanded E Grade!

A Grade: 701-1000
B Grade: 551-700
C Grade: 401-550
D Grade: 251-400
E Grade: 1-250

The Jerseys

The General Classification (GC) is decided by the cumulative elapsed time taken to complete all seven stages. The Team Classification is based on the combined time of each team's fastest three riders on every stage.
The Sprintteri and Vuorikauris (Mountain Goat) classifications are determined by a rider's cumulative time through all designated Sprint and KOM/QOM segments of Stages 2 to 7. Where a stage includes the same segment multiple times, only the rider's fastest time through that segment will count toward the classification.

The Johtaja (leader in Finnish) classification is decided by the cumulative elapsed time taken to complete all seven stages in each age category.

Upgrade Information

Riders who upgrade during the first six stages will be classified in their higher grade.  Riders who upgrade in Stage 7 will not be re-classified.

Further Information

Open events using Zwift’s Racing Score with separate results for Men and Women.
Each event is a mass start with all riders visible on the course.
TT bikes are mandatory for the iTT. Draft will be disabled.
Z Power and riders without heart rate data will be excluded from the results.
A rider's best time will count if they race the same stage in multiple zones.
To be included in the GC riders must have a Zwiftpower profile.
Team GC will be based on each team’s fastest three riders.

name: VO2sday Micro Race (1 of 5) by Zwift Insider
description:
Welcome to VO2sday - 5 short, back-to-back TT races designed to give you a properly structured VO2 Max workout in a motivating and engaging race!

RESULTS: Final race results combining all 5 events can be found at https://leadoutesports.com/vo2sday/. 

IMPORTANT: You need to create an account at Leadout and link it to your Zwift account to show up in race results.

All races are 4 minutes long. Whoever rides the furthest, wins! Be sure to complete all 5 races so you get a full workout and are included in the overall competition.

Because the goal is for you to hold your max power for the duration of each race, these are set up as mass-start time trial events. Drafting is disabled, so there's no 'sitting in.' Use the best TT frame and wheels you've got. Push as hard as you can for the race duration, then recover and do it again!

Categories are based on your compound score, which takes into account your 5-minute power and body weight, computed as (5-min power in W/kg) * (5-min power in W). Current category setup:

- A: 1600+
- B: 1200-1600
- C: 900-1200
- D: 900 and below

name: RCC Global Club Ride
description:
WELCOME TO THE RAPHA CYCLING CLUB WORLD WIDE GROUP RIDE. 

This is a social group workout; a chance every week for members to get together from around the globe, ride, chat and support each other - it’s run as a group workout session with ‘keep everyone together’ enabled so no matter what your pace you’ll stay in the pack - it’s not a race or competition and open for anyone to join us. 

We host 4 rides every week on a Tuesday to suit different time zones around the world (aimed at evenings), join whichever time works best for you. 
 
WHO IS THE RCC?
 
The Rapha Cycling Club (RCC) is, as the name suggests, Rapha’s Cycling Club. The RCC exists to help connect like minded riders from all over the world, underpinned by Rapha’s products and experiences. We ride together across continents and here united within Zwift. 
 
For more information head to: www.Rapha.cc/rcc
 
RIDE LEADERS
 
The rides are led by our friendly team of member ride leaders from around the world.  The Leader (who has a yellow beacon over their head) will ride at a steady pace as set by the workout session. Prompts will appear on screen set by the workout designer Matt Rowe so you know what to do throughout the ride. On most occasions we will have a support ride leader (who will also have a beacon), the ride leaders are there to help support you and keep the banter going - to join the chat use the Zwift Companion smartphone app. 
 
ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS
 
Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.
 
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

Today's workout contains 4 x 6 minute blocks of Zone 3, with some surges thrown in for good measure! The Zone 3 riding should feel nice and comfortable, however the surges may sting a little. The surges in each block are only 20 seconds long, but at 110% of FTP so require a focused increase in effort .At the end of each 6 minute block, there is a 1 minute 'Free Ride' - this is your chance to turn an endurance based session into something special! Come event day or when riding with friends, it's likely you want some more power for that final sprint to the cafe right? Give it 100% in each 60 second Free Ride section to help you become more explosive! Stress points 45: #Social
 
 
WORKOUT DESIGNER
 
Matt Rowe is the founder of Rowe & King Coaching (www.roweandking.com) with 25 years of cycling experience, coaching amateur cyclists all over the world to  achieve their personal goals.
 
HELPFUL HINT
 
We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level.
You can adjust the difficulty of the workout mid-ride if needed, by using the up/down arrows on the left hand side, under the workout details.
 
HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

name: ROAD TO ZWIFT RACING LEAGUE
description:
Team up. Show up. Race together.

Zwift Racing League is team racing at its best: fast, sweaty, and addictive. Race alongside your teammates every Tuesday, combining teamwork, tactics, and competition with the kind of Type 2 Fun that keeps you coming back for more.

The 2026/27 season features four 6-week rounds from September to April, with new routes, a new format, XP rewards, and exclusive unlocks along the way. Round 1 gets underway on September 22.

YOUR ROAD TO ZRL STARTS HERE

Thinking about racing ZRL? This group ride is designed to show you what it’s all about and help you get ready for the start line.
Ride alongside other Zwifters as we introduce you to team racing, what to expect when you race ZRL, and how to take the next step and join a team.

There’s no racing today. Just ride with the group, learn more about ZRL, and get ready to race together.

READY TO RACE?

Once you've completed the ride, the next step is to find your team and get signed up.

Getting started is simple:

1 - Create your WTRL profile by connecting your Zwift account.
2 - Visit the ZRL Find a Team page for ways to find a team.
3 - Or register your own team and invite your friends.

REGISTER NOW
https://www.wtrl.racing/zwift-racing-league/

name: PUMP: Loop Logic II — Tuesday (2 Laps)
description:
Same Distance. More Laps. Maximum Sass. ♥️🌶️

Welcome to Loop Logic, the weekday series where we prove that "going in circles" is actually a superpower. We’ve curated a week of routes that hit the 19–25km sweet spot with enough climbing to keep your glutes talking back to you.

The Logic is Simple:
We start with one big loop on Monday and add a lap every day until Friday. One lap is a warm-up, but five laps is a statement.

The PUMP Vibe:
Power in Numbers: No band here, ladies! This is your chance to find your rhythm, tuck into a friendly draft, and realize you’re much faster than you think.

Elevation is Our Love Language: Expect at least 100m of climb—just enough to feel the PUMP and earn that post-ride coffee.

Laughter > Watts: We ride hard, but we laugh harder. Whether you’re smashing a PR or just hanging onto a wheel for dear life, do it with a smile.

The Mission:
Show up for yourself, stay for the sisterhood, and let’s show exactly what women-powered logic looks like.

name: VO2sday Micro Race (3 of 5) by Zwift Insider
description:
Welcome to VO2sday - 5 short, back-to-back TT races designed to give you a properly structured VO2 Max workout in a motivating and engaging race!

RESULTS: Final race results combining all 5 events can be found at https://leadoutesports.com/vo2sday/. 

IMPORTANT: You need to create an account at Leadout and link it to your Zwift account to show up in race results.

All races are 4 minutes long. Whoever rides the furthest, wins! Be sure to complete all 5 races so you get a full workout and are included in the overall competition.

Because the goal is for you to hold your max power for the duration of each race, these are set up as mass-start time trial events. Drafting is disabled, so there's no 'sitting in.' Use the best TT frame and wheels you've got. Push as hard as you can for the race duration, then recover and do it again!

Categories are based on your compound score, which takes into account your 5-minute power and body weight, computed as (5-min power in W/kg) * (5-min power in W). Current category setup:

- A: 1600+
- B: 1200-1600
- C: 900-1200
- D: 900 and below

name: ZZRC Chain Reaction Sub 2
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Chain Reaction Sub 2. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 1.7-1.9 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be sub 2 .

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel for our sub 2
https://discord.gg/RJ3dhbjCEp


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

Races will be regularly featured in the WKG ‘Watts Up!’ Vlogs (https://www.youtube.com/c/WKG111 <https://www.youtube.com/c/WKG111>) or live streamed on the Team WKG Facebook page (https://www.facebook.com/zwiftoholic/ <https://www.facebook.com/zwiftoholic/>).

Race Rules:
1. You MUST have a zwiftpower profile
2. You must select your category correctly, based on recent race history or FTP tests. WKG reserves the right to disqualify any racers that have obviously entered the wrong category.
3. NO TT bikes (except for the time trial stages)
4. ALL power-ups are allowed.
5. You MUST use a heart rate monitor.

Ride Hard, Ride Smart, Ride Fair, Ride On!

name: ZHCC RUBBERBAND CLUB
description:
Want a 100% guaranteed no drop ride? want a 100% guarantee you can ride at your own pace? want a 100% guarantee you WILL stay in the group,? want a 100% guarantee that the nasty fence will NOT kick you...........THEN LOOK NO FURTHER, this is the ride for you.
Try it - YOU MIGHT JUST LIKE IT!
Our ZHCC Rubber Band Club has the “rubber-band” activated which means that no matter what level you are, you will be able to keep up and the group WILL STAY TOGETHER. The rubber band allows you to ride at your own pace, slow or fast and you are guaranteed to stay in the group.
The ride speed will be slightly less than you would normally experience in a group ride due to the rubber band effect, but we feel that's a small price to pay to allow all level of riders to remain together throughout the ride.
In this supportive environment it’s a great way of completing a full 1 hour ride knowing you wont get dropped or get dragged along by those naughty fliers!
ZHCC do not race each other, we ride as one, have fun and enjoy a group ride.
The ZHCC gang look forward to riding with you.

description:

name: Norwegian Watts Club BANDED social ride
description:
Welcome to Norwegian Watts Club social ride🙂

This ride is for all abilities--from first-timers to seasoned cyclists. Thanks to then banded ride feature, nobody gets left behind: as long as you keep pedaling, you'll stay with the group.
That means you can ride at your own pace,  focus on enjoying the route, and still be part of the bunch the whole way.

Our goal is simple: create a relaxed and supportive atmosphere where everyone feels at home. 
This ride isn't about Watts, KOMs, or race tactics-- it's about community,  good conversation,  and sharing the ride together.  Whether you're here to spin your legs,  make new Zwift friends,  or just enjoy some easy miles with like-minded rider, you'll find a warm welcome with the Norwegian Watts Club. 

What to Expect:

*All riders welcome -- no matter your pace or experience 

*Bande ride -- stick with the group just by pedaling 

*Social atmosphere  -- chat, laugh, encourage and ride together 

* A fun and supportive community 

So fire up Zwift, clip in and come ride with us.
It's not about how fast you go -- it's about who you ride with.

Welcome to Norwegian Watts Club social ride🙂

This ride is for all abilities--from first-timers to seasoned cyclists. Thanks to then banded ride feature, nobody gets left behind: as long as you keep pedaling, you'll stay with the group.
That means you can ride at your own pace,  focus on enjoying the route, and still be part of the bunch the whole way.

Our goal is simple: create a relaxed and supportive atmosphere where everyone feels at home. 
This ride isn't about Watts, KOMs, or race tactics-- it's about community,  good conversation,  and sharing the ride together.  Whether you're here to spin your legs,  make new Zwift friends,  or just enjoy some easy miles with like-minded rider, you'll find a warm welcome with the Norwegian Watts Club. 

What to Expect:

*All riders welcome -- no matter your pace or experience 

*Bande ride -- stick with the group just by pedaling 

*Social atmosphere  -- chat, laugh, encourage and ride together 

* A fun and supportive community 

So fire up Zwift, clip in and come ride with us.
It's not about how fast you go -- it's about who you ride with.

name: Zwift Crit Racing Club - Neokyo Crit Course
description:
It's Crit time! Come and join in the fun on a number of multi-lap short routes. Get ready to dig deep and push to the finish line!

What is Racing Score?

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. This score helps Zwift recommend the most competitive band to race in, ensuring a fun, rewarding, and exciting experience as you track your progression throughout your Zwift racing adventures.

WHAT IS ZWIFT POWER? For further information on connecting to Zwift Power check out this support page: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/connecting-to-zwiftpower-SyldRc_4H

Please note; for your results to show up in Zwift Power you must be using a Heart Rate Monitor (HRM) and be riding on a smart trainer, smart bike, or using a power meter.

name: Glorious Gravel Off:Road Race Series
description:
Welcome to the Glorious Gravel Off:Road Race Series.
Join us every Tuesday & Thursday for our gravel race series.
Today we head to Watopia for 4 laps of Handful of Gravel, a lumpy off road route with rolling climbs and fast descents. Today's race is a handicap with the D's going off first. Start times are:
Start - Cat D
Plus 3 mins - Cat C
Plus 6 mins - Cat B
Plus 8 mins - Cat A
You will need to work with your fellow riders to catch / stay away from the other categories but this is an individual race so at some point, teamwork goes away and it's every ride for themselves 👊👊. Good Luck!

name: Run in the Park Group 5km's'
description:
Join us for a structured 5km progressive workout event, with each group targeting a
specific finish time so you can choose the effort that fits your goals.
-
Every group includes a progressive 5km run workout where the pace increases each
kilometre, finishing with a fast 400m free run to let you open up and push hard to the
line.
-
A warmup and cooldown segment is included, giving a total event distance of 6km
for Groups A, B and C with Groups D and E having a shorter warmup/cooldown
distance to slightly shorten the overall run to 5.4km and 5.6km respectively.
-
Group A: 5km in 20 minutes (600m warmup + 400m cooldown; 6.0km total)
-
Group B: 5km in 25 minutes (600m warmup + 400m cooldown; 6.0km total)
-
Group C: 5km in 30 minutes (600m warmup + 400m cooldown; 6.0km total)
-
Group D: 5km in 35 minutes (400m warmup + 200m cooldown; 5.6km total)
-
Group E: 5km in 40 minutes (200m warmup + 200m cooldown; 5.4km total)
-
Choose the group based on the time you want to run for your progressive 5km (not
including the warmup/cooldown). This is a workout event designed to allow people
to run together, not a race.
-
There is a 10-minute post-event cooldown period for chatting and congratulating
fellow runners
This is a great session for improving your 5km speed, practicing pacing discipline, or
simply enjoying a group workout with structure and purpose.

name: The Tour 21 Tuesday Social
description:
Welcome to The Tour 21 Tuesday Social, a social ride led by Ribble Cycles ambassadors Cam Jeffers and Katie Kookaburra. Join us to celebrate this year’s Tour 21, which sees 18 amateurs take on the full 2022 Tour de France route ahead of the pros with a mission to raise £1 million for Cure Leukaemia, the official charity partner of the Tour de France in the UK. All levels are welcome and we’re keeping things strictly social so we can all ride together (2.2 - 2.7 w/kg). Keep an eye on the ride leader’s yellow beacon to help keep the group together - ride sweepers will also help anyone get back on if they lose contact with the group.
It’s time to live the Tour, feel the Tour and ride the Tour!

🔥 Tuesday Power Builder is our structured workout session, focused on building strength and fitness through clear, guided intervals. Riders are encouraged to work within their own limits and focus on quality rather than comparison.

name: Mountain Massif Mini TT series - Race 1 s/b Hyperice
description:
This event is designed to replicate a prologue, which is a short individual time trial (ITT) held at the beginning of a stage race.

The race will test your ability to go "" full throttle " for a very short period of time and to push yourself beyond your perceived limits. On occasions, there will be a slightly longer time trial, where you can target hitting your best 20-minute power numbers.

With the same equipment being used, this is the ultimate “Race of truth” as a legendary commentator.
Phil Liggett described it.

There are three races on offer, which form part of a series where the overall winner will be the one who completes the three races, with the most accumulated points, which are awarded depending on your finishing position.

Alternatively, you can target one race and go for that individual win; the choice is yours. This event is sponsored by Hyperice.

About Hyperice:
They create innovative products that are designed to relieve tension, help sore muscles, and aid recovery. 

Founded in 2011 by Anthony Katz, Hyperice has worked to push the boundaries of innovation to
help better serve athletes everywhere.
 
Rules: 
Heart Rate monitor required and Zwift Power for official results, the winner of each category.
 
More information:
For more information, check out the Mountain Massif website www.mountainmassif.com, follow on
Instagram, Mountain_Massif, and join our Zwift Club, by clicking the link below: 
https://www.zwift.com/clubs/mountainmassif/home

name: ROAD TO ZWIFT RACING LEAGUE
description:
Team up. Show up. Race together.

Zwift Racing League is team racing at its best: fast, sweaty, and addictive. Race alongside your teammates every Tuesday, combining teamwork, tactics, and competition with the kind of Type 2 Fun that keeps you coming back for more.

The 2026/27 season features four 6-week rounds from September to April, with new routes, a new format, XP rewards, and exclusive unlocks along the way. Round 1 gets underway on September 22.

YOUR ROAD TO ZRL STARTS HERE

Thinking about racing ZRL? This group ride is designed to show you what it’s all about and help you get ready for the start line.
Ride alongside other Zwifters as we introduce you to team racing, what to expect when you race ZRL, and how to take the next step and join a team.

There’s no racing today. Just ride with the group, learn more about ZRL, and get ready to race together.

READY TO RACE?

Once you've completed the ride, the next step is to find your team and get signed up.

Getting started is simple:

1 - Create your WTRL profile by connecting your Zwift account.
2 - Visit the ZRL Find a Team page for ways to find a team.
3 - Or register your own team and invite your friends.

REGISTER NOW
https://www.wtrl.racing/zwift-racing-league/

name: Zwift Women's Training Club Workout
description:
Welcome to the Zwift Women’s Training Club workouts! 

ZWTC is your community for fun and fitness. Our weekly workouts will take you through some of Zwift’s most popular training plans, and with the flexibility to join in any time, regardless of where we are in the plan! Get the most out of your Zwifting with training designed by world-class coaches, like 3x Olympic Gold medalist, Kristin Armstrong!

The group workouts will be held every 3 hours UTC on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We’ll also offer recovery rides every 3 hours on Wednesdays - be on the look out for special guests joining those! Our main goal is to provide you with a consistent experience week in and week out, to challenge yourself in a supportive group setting, making friends and getting fit along the way! 

Join the Zwift Women’s Training Club to connect with new ride friends, ask questions, and get advice from experts.  https://www.zwift.com/clubs/ZwiftWTC/join

Love these workouts? Check out the club for more opportunities to train with us! We offer social rides every 3 hours on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays in addition to the Tuesday/Thursday workouts.

name: Velos Tuesday Grimpeurs
description:
Grimpeurs are cycling’s climbing specialists, so join Velos and build those climbing muscles in the company of a friendly group! We explore the hillier routes in Zwift at a moderate D pace (average 2.0 w/kg, as we move you through each week from an easy D pace on Mondays (1.5 w/kg) suitable for beginners to a more challenging C pace on Thursdays (2.3 w/kg). Tuesday Grimpeurs will help you build your strength and confidence pacing on hills whilst accumulating climbing feet/metres towards the Everest Challenge. Some days we will complete climbs, others we will practice pacing on shorter climbs or tackle long climbs that can be finished as an ‘after party’ following the event end. There is no better way to get more comfortable climbing than with a fun & supportive group! Get stronger and meet your fitness targets with Velos.

Join our social group on Facebook at www.teamvelos.co.uk

name: SISU Punainen - Stage 2
description:
SISU Racing launches its boldest challenge yet: SISU Punainen, a Vuelta-inspired, seven-stage race series built for riders who thrive when the road tilts skyward. Set entirely in Watopia, this inaugural edition is unapologetically brutal, beautifully relentless, and designed for the mountain goats of the virtual peloton.

Riders will compete for three individual classifications, ensuring every stage offers something to race for. The coveted Punainen (red in FInnish) Jersey rewards the overall General Classification leader based on cumulative elapsed time across all seven stages. The Sprintteri Jersey recognises the fastest riders through the designated sprint segments, while the Vuorikauris (Mountain Goat) Jersey celebrates the strongest climbers.  Whether you're an all-rounder, a sprinter or a pure climber, there's a jersey to chase.
Just like the Vuelta, SISU Punainen rewards courage, consistency, and climbing prowess.

For more information, and results, visit sisu.racing/punainen.

The Stages

Stage 1
Hilly Route, Watopia (Individual Time Trial)
Sat 22 & Sun 23 August

Stage 2
Mayan San Remo, Watopia
Tue 25 & Wed 26 August

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 3
Three Little Sisters, Watopia
Sat 29 & Sun 30 August

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 4
Climbers Gambit, Watopia
Tue 1 & Wed 2 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 5
Big Loop, Watopia
Sat 5 & Sun 6 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 6
Mountain 8, Watopia
Tue 8 & Wed 9 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 7
Mountain Route, Watopia
Sat 12 & Sun 13 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather, Aero or Anvil


Zwift Race Score

In our ongoing effort to keep the racing scene fresh and competitive, the upcoming SISU Punainen series is embracing Zwift's flexible new Zwift Racing Score (ZRS) framework!
Following a format similar to the recent Zwift Tour Fever series, this shift away from standard Category boundaries allows us to create tighter, more closely matched fields.

What this means for you:

A Shakeup in the Pack: If you usually find yourself stuck in the middle of a traditional category, this is your chance to step up, animate the race, and battle for the win.
New Challenges for Front-Runners: Former category leaders will be pushed to find new limits against a freshly recalibrated field.
Dynamic Racing Throughout: While the elite action in A Grade will remain as fierce as ever, expect highly competitive, unpredictable, and dynamic racing across the board - especially in Cat D Grade and expanded E Grade!

A Grade: 701-1000
B Grade: 551-700
C Grade: 401-550
D Grade: 251-400
E Grade: 1-250

The Jerseys

The General Classification (GC) is decided by the cumulative elapsed time taken to complete all seven stages. The Team Classification is based on the combined time of each team's fastest three riders on every stage.
The Sprintteri and Vuorikauris (Mountain Goat) classifications are determined by a rider's cumulative time through all designated Sprint and KOM/QOM segments of Stages 2 to 7. Where a stage includes the same segment multiple times, only the rider's fastest time through that segment will count toward the classification.

The Johtaja (leader in Finnish) classification is decided by the cumulative elapsed time taken to complete all seven stages in each age category.

Upgrade Information

Riders who upgrade during the first six stages will be classified in their higher grade.  Riders who upgrade in Stage 7 will not be re-classified.

Further Information

Open events using Zwift’s Racing Score with separate results for Men and Women.
Each event is a mass start with all riders visible on the course.
TT bikes are mandatory for the iTT. Draft will be disabled.
Z Power and riders without heart rate data will be excluded from the results.
A rider's best time will count if they race the same stage in multiple zones.
To be included in the GC riders must have a Zwiftpower profile.
Team GC will be based on each team’s fastest three riders.

name: Mountain Massif Mini TT series - Race 3
description:
This event is designed to replicate a prologue, which is a short individual time trial (ITT) held at the beginning of a stage race.

The race will test your ability to go "" full throttle"" for a very short period of time and to push yourself beyond your perceived limits. On occasions, there will be a slightly longer time trial, where you can target hitting your best 20-minute power numbers.

With the same equipment being used, this is the ultimate “Race of truth” as a legendary commentator. Phil Liggett described it.

There are three races on offer, which form part of a series where the overall winner will be the one who completes the three races, with the most accumulated points, which are awarded depending on your finishing position.

Alternatively, you can target one race and go for that individual win; the choice is yours. This event is sponsored by Hyperice.
 
Rules: 
Heart Rate monitor required and Zwift Power for official results, the winner of each category.
 
More information:
For more information, check out the Mountain Massif website www.mountainmassif.com, follow on Instagram, Mountain_Massif, and join our Zwift Club by clicking the link below:
https://www.zwift.com/clubs/mountainmassif/home

name: Team Rynkeby - Europe's most meaningful cycling team!
description:
In Bologna, the prolog for 2019 Giro d'Italia awaits.
We begin at Piazza Maggiore, which is the main square in the heart of Bologna. Other sights here include the Basilica di San Petronio and Fountain of Neptune.
Next, we cover some cobbled streets lined with arcades, past Porta San Felice (the westernmost gate of medieval Bologna).
The climb begins at Arco del Meloncello with a sharp right hairpin. You’ll know you’re halfway up the climb when you hit another right hairpin and go under the stone arch. When you see the Sanctuary of the Madonna di San Luca you’ll know you’re almost there. And when you see the giant Scottie inflatable, give it all you’ve got over the line!
And then we turn around, ride back to the starting point, and do it all again :-D
- An important element of Team Rynkeby’s work is raising money for organisations that support children with critical illnesses. The money is raised from a variety of sources including sponsorships from generous businesses. Team Rynkeby is a voluntary initiative, which means that we rely on sponsors to supply many of the things we need for our trip. This includes vehicles, fuel, food and beverages. Our participants pay their own way via the participation fee. Via its three brands – Rynkeby, God Morgon and hohes C – the German juice group, Eckes-Granini covers the major costs of the project in cooperation with the organisations for which the money is raised. This means that all the money raised is donated to organisations that help children with critical illnesses. Join our Discord-channel: https://discord.gg/dVvd7azK6s

name: TOUR HISP 2026 Stage 2
description:
Tour de HISP 2026

This is HISP’s most challenging and exigent event, now in its fifth edition.

We will race 13 stages in 14 days, starting on August 24th. There will be four starts each day, so you can choose whichever fits your schedule best. You can even repeat a stage, but only your best time will count for the General Classification (GC).

Standings will be calculated by simple time addition, just like a classic stage race. Categories will be assigned according to the ZCE system.

You can find more information on the stages and schedule here: https://hispevents.com

You can find the GC (ZwiftPower) here: https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=3324

***

Tour de HISP 2026

Este es el evento más exigente de HISP, nuestro mayor desafío, que llega ya a su quinta edición.

Serán trece etapas en catorce días, arrancando el 24 de agosto. Contaremos con cuatro salidas diarias para que puedas escoger la que mejor te convenga. Puedes repetir la etapa si lo deseas, pero solamente contará tu mejor tiempo para la Clasificación General (GC).

La clasificación se calculará por suma simple de tiempos, como en una carrera clásica por etapas. Las categorías se regirán por el sistema ZCE.

Puedes encontrar toda la información sobre el evento y las etapas aquí: https://hispevents.com

name: Wahooligan Official Group Workout
description:
Join fellow Wahooligan riders for a challenging workout in Watopia!

This workout is focused on aerobic conditioning, getting your aerobic system revved up for some harder training session ahead. In this workout we accumulate a total of 30min 'work' with the majority of that below your FTP. We split this workout into x3 10min segments but within each segment we have x2 1 min bursts above FTP. These 1min bursts rise from 102% up to 107% over the 3 blocks.

name: VTTA 10 miles Time Trial
description:
Zwift VTTA Ten Mile TT series

Join in with the VTTA (Veterans Time Trials Association) for a classic time trial on Zwift! This 10-mile TT is a true test of your power and pacing. Push your limits and see how you stack up against other riders in a race against the clock. See how your times compare week on week through the series.

About the VTTA

The Veterans Time Trials Association (VTTA) is an organization for cyclists aged 40 and over who are interested in time trials. The VTTA uses a unique ""age-adjusted"" handicapping system to level the playing field for riders of all ages to allow for fair regardless of their age. The VTTA also maintains national age records and organizes various competitions and championships in real life.

Event Details:

Distance: 10 miles (16.1 km)
Format: Time Trial
Bike: TT bikes are allowed and highly recommended

Important Notes:

This is a time trial, so drafting is disabled.
Power-ups are also disabled to ensure a fair and pure test of your fitness.
Smart trainer or a Power Meter must be used. Sorry no ZPower users

Please ensure your ZwiftPower account is connected to your Zwift account for accurate results. If you are a VTTA member remember to put VTTA and your membership number after your name in ZPower so we can put your results in the league tables..

Get ready to suffer and set a new personal best! Good luck!

name: ROAD TO ZWIFT RACING LEAGUE
description:
Team up. Show up. Race together.

Zwift Racing League is team racing at its best: fast, sweaty, and addictive. Race alongside your teammates every Tuesday, combining teamwork, tactics, and competition with the kind of Type 2 Fun that keeps you coming back for more.

The 2026/27 season features four 6-week rounds from September to April, with new routes, a new format, XP rewards, and exclusive unlocks along the way. Round 1 gets underway on September 22.

YOUR ROAD TO ZRL STARTS HERE

Thinking about racing ZRL? This group ride is designed to show you what it’s all about and help you get ready for the start line.
Ride alongside other Zwifters as we introduce you to team racing, what to expect when you race ZRL, and how to take the next step and join a team.

There’s no racing today. Just ride with the group, learn more about ZRL, and get ready to race together.

READY TO RACE?

Once you've completed the ride, the next step is to find your team and get signed up.

Getting started is simple:

1 - Create your WTRL profile by connecting your Zwift account.
2 - Visit the ZRL Find a Team page for ways to find a team.
3 - Or register your own team and invite your friends.

REGISTER NOW
https://www.wtrl.racing/zwift-racing-league/

name: GGCC Glasgow Green CC Tuesday Training ride
description:
GGCC group rides are TRAINING events, category C, with a yellow beacon leader. The beacon leader will ride to 2.5w/kg pace average wherever possible.

Please look out for our training rides 3 days a week, every week - Tuesdays at 20.45 UTC, Thursdays at 21.00 UTC and Saturdays at 11.30am UTC. Use #ggcc to search, as in https://zwift.com/events/tag/ggcc

The Glasgow Green Cycle Club (GGCC) training rides are intended to provide a challenge for riders, and are open to all timezones. You should ride as a group, following the instructions of the beacon ride leader(s) for any sprints, intervals and spicy segments, regrouping after each when requested. All our group rides also have a closing minirace, to start from behind the beacon.

GGCC is a Glasgow based cycling club whose “in real life” (irl) club runs and training rides are always organized into pace groups, which match the Zwift categories quite well. GGCC also has a good race pedigree and presence in Scotland, and so we have organized this training ride series to suit what we believe is relevant to bike riders’ interests in performance and improvement in our club, in other Glasgow clubs, in Scotland and the UK. Racers will, no doubt, aspire to try our other events, both our Monday 20.10 UTC Zwift races, and our Friday 19.45 UTC TTs.

As we expect our club’s riders to be able to ride 50 miles at a 15mph average on our Sunday rides, such steady riding members will be comfortable with Zwift Category C, and in our various rides we cater for all abilities, through the Zwift ABCD levels. Beacon leaders communicate via Zwift messaging (always) and/or Discord (sometimes) to vary the pace to allow for sprints, intervals, and optionally a mini-race towards the end of the rides, with regrouping after each segment. Make as much use of drafting as you can, for more effective sprinting and intervals.

Results can be seen at the end of the ride on screen, and we will, in common with many other ride series, publish your results on zwiftpower.com too, based on each category.

All bikes and PUs are allowed, but better not to use TT bikes (which don’t draft) on our group rides and races. Please add GGCC (X) to your Zwift name to allow your ride presence to be recognized, where X is your desired ride category. Categories are related to your Functional Threshold Power (FTP); use your FTP and then divide by your weight in kg, then pick the correct ride and group.

C: 2 W/kg to 3 W/kg FTP; the beacon leader will ride to 2.5w/kg pace average.

PLEASE NOTE: Strava data for our rides must be open (not private or hidden). Please use a heart monitor so that we can monitor correlated power and heart rate to help assure fair riding.
You can use our Discord channel to talk to each other at https://discord.gg/UDhdEQA
Please see the GGCC Zwift page link at http://www.glasgowgreencycleclub.co.uk/ for more.

For more about specific Zwift courses for our events, see the Zwift Companion schedule, and also https://zwiftinsider.com/ where there is a wealth of information about all things Zwift.

#ggcc

name: AHDR Bacon Rolls with Caffeine
description:
Welcome to AHDR Bacon Rolls with Caffeine.
It’s hump day morning and should you need something a little extra to get you through to the weekend, you’ve come to the right place!

We ride with the beacons for the first part of the event enjoying the blobbiness and banter that AHDR brings with a pace around 2.5-3.0W/kg. Then just before the last lap/s, you have a decision to make - race the CAFFEINE lap or join the RED beacon to finish the event at pre-caffeine pace.

There's even a lower grade version (without the racing) with the "D-Caff" group, that starts 5 mins later. It really is an event with something for everyone!

Have a blast, have a laugh, and enjoy the fun that is AHDR Bacon Rolls, but with a splash of CAFFEINE! Should you sleep in, or hit snooze, you may Join/Rejoin for up to 30 minutes.

#AHDR

name: TPR Pelo x Attaquer - Maeve Plouffe
description:
For this week's ride we are partnering with the Attaquer crew who will be joining TPR Pelo ride! There will be a sweet Attaquer prize pack up for grabs during the ride so make sure you bunch up to the beacon and stay close to Jethro (hint, hint)

The Pelo is an easy 60-minute weekly ride where we can talk a bit about our favourite Aussie cyclists and how they are going over in Europe and start some discussions as to what we think will happen in the upcoming races each week. The ride will automatically play the latest episode of The Press Room Podcast presented by Zwift so, if you prefer to simply listen and pedal then you are more than welcome to tag along with us and be apart of the community!

The Press Room Podcast is a cycling podcast featuring extended interviews with some of the world's best cyclists, key staff personnel and other notable cycling personalities. Through thought provoking and casual "on the couch" interviews, The Press Room pulls back the curtains on professional cyclists to highlight the stories, relationships and characters that are often hidden beyond the results sheet.

The Press Room Podcast presented by Zwift is available for download on all podcast players such as Spotify, Apple and Google podcasts. Be sure to subscribe to the pod and follow the Instagram and Youtube channel for all the latest updates.

Join The Press Room Pelo CC Zwift Club!

Episode 8 of TPR features Australia's most exciting prospect on the track and on the road - Maeve Plouffe. Maeve runs us through her recent success at the Track Nationals (despite some challenges) where she won back the IP title, her World Tour ambitions on the road for 2023 and we discuss how she got into the sport before diving deep in to the art of sprinting and who inspires her as a female athlete.

The Press Room podcast is presented by our title sponsor Zwift.

name: ROAD TO ZWIFT RACING LEAGUE
description:
Team up. Show up. Race together.

Zwift Racing League is team racing at its best: fast, sweaty, and addictive. Race alongside your teammates every Tuesday, combining teamwork, tactics, and competition with the kind of Type 2 Fun that keeps you coming back for more.

The 2026/27 season features four 6-week rounds from September to April, with new routes, a new format, XP rewards, and exclusive unlocks along the way. Round 1 gets underway on September 22.

YOUR ROAD TO ZRL STARTS HERE

Thinking about racing ZRL? This group ride is designed to show you what it’s all about and help you get ready for the start line.
Ride alongside other Zwifters as we introduce you to team racing, what to expect when you race ZRL, and how to take the next step and join a team.

There’s no racing today. Just ride with the group, learn more about ZRL, and get ready to race together.

READY TO RACE?

Once you've completed the ride, the next step is to find your team and get signed up.

Getting started is simple:

1 - Create your WTRL profile by connecting your Zwift account.
2 - Visit the ZRL Find a Team page for ways to find a team.
3 - Or register your own team and invite your friends.

REGISTER NOW
https://www.wtrl.racing/zwift-racing-league/

name: Zwift Women's Training Club Workout
description:
Welcome to the Zwift Women’s Training Club workouts! 

ZWTC is your community for fun and fitness. Our weekly workouts will take you through some of Zwift’s most popular training plans, and with the flexibility to join in any time, regardless of where we are in the plan! Get the most out of your Zwifting with training designed by world-class coaches, like 3x Olympic Gold medalist, Kristin Armstrong!

The group workouts will be held every 3 hours UTC on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We’ll also offer recovery rides every 3 hours on Wednesdays - be on the look out for special guests joining those! Our main goal is to provide you with a consistent experience week in and week out, to challenge yourself in a supportive group setting, making friends and getting fit along the way! 

Join the Zwift Women’s Training Club to connect with new ride friends, ask questions, and get advice from experts.  https://www.zwift.com/clubs/ZwiftWTC/join

Love these workouts? Check out the club for more opportunities to train with us! We offer social rides every 3 hours on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays in addition to the Tuesday/Thursday workouts.

name: SISU Punainen - Stage 2
description:
SISU Racing launches its boldest challenge yet: SISU Punainen, a Vuelta-inspired, seven-stage race series built for riders who thrive when the road tilts skyward. Set entirely in Watopia, this inaugural edition is unapologetically brutal, beautifully relentless, and designed for the mountain goats of the virtual peloton.

Riders will compete for three individual classifications, ensuring every stage offers something to race for. The coveted Punainen (red in FInnish) Jersey rewards the overall General Classification leader based on cumulative elapsed time across all seven stages. The Sprintteri Jersey recognises the fastest riders through the designated sprint segments, while the Vuorikauris (Mountain Goat) Jersey celebrates the strongest climbers.  Whether you're an all-rounder, a sprinter or a pure climber, there's a jersey to chase.
Just like the Vuelta, SISU Punainen rewards courage, consistency, and climbing prowess.

For more information, and results, visit sisu.racing/punainen.

The Stages

Stage 1
Hilly Route, Watopia (Individual Time Trial)
Sat 22 & Sun 23 August

Stage 2
Mayan San Remo, Watopia
Tue 25 & Wed 26 August

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 3
Three Little Sisters, Watopia
Sat 29 & Sun 30 August

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 4
Climbers Gambit, Watopia
Tue 1 & Wed 2 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 5
Big Loop, Watopia
Sat 5 & Sun 6 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 6
Mountain 8, Watopia
Tue 8 & Wed 9 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 7
Mountain Route, Watopia
Sat 12 & Sun 13 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather, Aero or Anvil


Zwift Race Score

In our ongoing effort to keep the racing scene fresh and competitive, the upcoming SISU Punainen series is embracing Zwift's flexible new Zwift Racing Score (ZRS) framework!
Following a format similar to the recent Zwift Tour Fever series, this shift away from standard Category boundaries allows us to create tighter, more closely matched fields.

What this means for you:

A Shakeup in the Pack: If you usually find yourself stuck in the middle of a traditional category, this is your chance to step up, animate the race, and battle for the win.
New Challenges for Front-Runners: Former category leaders will be pushed to find new limits against a freshly recalibrated field.
Dynamic Racing Throughout: While the elite action in A Grade will remain as fierce as ever, expect highly competitive, unpredictable, and dynamic racing across the board - especially in Cat D Grade and expanded E Grade!

A Grade: 701-1000
B Grade: 551-700
C Grade: 401-550
D Grade: 251-400
E Grade: 1-250

The Jerseys

The General Classification (GC) is decided by the cumulative elapsed time taken to complete all seven stages. The Team Classification is based on the combined time of each team's fastest three riders on every stage.
The Sprintteri and Vuorikauris (Mountain Goat) classifications are determined by a rider's cumulative time through all designated Sprint and KOM/QOM segments of Stages 2 to 7. Where a stage includes the same segment multiple times, only the rider's fastest time through that segment will count toward the classification.

The Johtaja (leader in Finnish) classification is decided by the cumulative elapsed time taken to complete all seven stages in each age category.

Upgrade Information

Riders who upgrade during the first six stages will be classified in their higher grade.  Riders who upgrade in Stage 7 will not be re-classified.

Further Information

Open events using Zwift’s Racing Score with separate results for Men and Women.
Each event is a mass start with all riders visible on the course.
TT bikes are mandatory for the iTT. Draft will be disabled.
Z Power and riders without heart rate data will be excluded from the results.
A rider's best time will count if they race the same stage in multiple zones.
To be included in the GC riders must have a Zwiftpower profile.
Team GC will be based on each team’s fastest three riders.

The Ride to End ALZ South Carolina is a three-day, cross-state journey for cycling enthusiasts. Participants may also ride at their own pace from anywhere in our month-long Virtual Challenge. Either way, funds raised by riders benefit the Alzheimer's Association and fuel cutting-edge research targeted to change the trajectory of Alzheimer’s disease.
